newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Terminal July-Sept Q1 net up 39 pct.
newsitem.headline: Asian Terminal July-Sept Q1 net up 39 pct.

text.p: Port operator Asian Terminals Inc on Friday reported that its consolidated net income rose by 39.5 percent to 84.89 million pesos in the first quarter of the fiscal year starting July.
ATI said the figure exceeded its target of 73.91 million pesos thanks to the start of commercial operations at the Mariveles Grain Terminal which contributed 30 percent of net income.
Group revenues for the first quarter increased by 24.2 percent to 527.54 million pesos from 424.85 million pesos a year ago.
The company said it expects its performance to improve with the start of commercial operations at its inland clearance depot before the end of the year.
The depot, in Laguna south of Manila, will ease container traffic in Manila's South Harbour which ATI operates.
